source.title: Hilfe, ich bin ein Mensch! — Human Nature Science Wrestling

production.stylePrompt: Solo English spoken-word stand-up; dry clear characterful narration; no singing; no background instruments, no soundbed; short distinct pauses between cards; let source irony land without extra punchlines.

cards.text: CHARLES DARWIN. Sympathy Instinct: Play to cancel a "Selfish" action. Sympathy will have been increased through natural selection. (Ref: Darwin)
Do you know THE SELFISH GENE? Ego Boost: Gain control of the narrative, but isolate your Actor. We are survival machines—robot vehicles blindly programmed. (Ref: Dawkins)
LYNN MARGULIS. Symbiosis: Combine two Scene cards into one stronger card. Life did not take over the globe by combat, but by networking. (Ref: Margulis)
SURVIVAL OF THE FRIENDLIEST. Domestication: Turn an enemy card into an ally. Evolution favors those who can get along. (Ref: Hare & Wrangham)
Ever heard of MIRROR NEURONS? Reflection: Copy the Effect/Power of the last card played. Why I feel what you feel. Intuitive communication. (Ref: Bauer)
OXYTOCIN. The Cuddle Hormone: Heal a fractured Stage or lower the Quest Die by 1. Increases trust, reduces fear. Warning: Can cause aggression against 'outsiders'.
THE VAGUS NERVE. Calm Down: Reset the Quest Die to 3. The wandering nerve of compassion. Stimulate for peace.
PAIN CENTER. Social Reject: Inflict 'Damage' on an Actor who is ignored. Social rejection activates the same brain regions as physical pain. (Ref: Lieberman)
Do you know THOMAS HOBBES? Leviathan: Impose strict order. No other player may speak this turn. "Life is nasty, brutish, and short. War of all against all."
JEAN-JACQUES ROUSSEAU. Natural Goodness: Remove a 'Corruption' or 'Civilization' effect. "Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains."
RUTGER BREGMAN. Humankind: Re-roll the die if the result was cynical/negative. "Most people, deep down, are pretty decent." (Ref: Im Grunde gut)
Ever heard of LORD OF THE FLIES? Fiction Trap: Create a false conflict. "A story we tell ourselves. Real kids on islands cooperated. (Ref: Golding vs. Reality)"
MICHAEL TOMASELLO. Pointing: Reveal a hidden card from another player's hand. "We cooperate to survive. Shared Intentionality. (Ref: Why We Cooperate)"
THE STAG HUNT. Joint Effort: Works only if another player helps. Effect is doubled. "I can't catch the stag alone. If I chase the rabbit, we both lose."
THE FREE RIDER. Exploit: Steal the benefit of the previous player's action. The fear of being suckered. The reason we invented punishment.
Do you know THE COMMONS? Elinor Ostrom: All players draw 1 card. What we share grows, unless we believe the tragedy myth. (Ref: Ostrom)
FRANS DE WAAL. Reconciliation: Restore peace after a conflict scene. "Empathy is biological, not a choice. The Age of Empathy."
THE PSYCHOPATH. CEO Status: Ignore the negative consequences of a decision. "1% of people. 4% of CEOs. They know the lyrics but not the music."
Ever heard of EMOTIONAL CONTAGION? Vibe Check: Change the mood of the Stage to match your Actor. "We catch feelings faster than viruses. (Ref: Christakis)"
VENEER THEORY. Cynicism: Negate a "Good" act. "The myth that civilization is just a thin layer over a beast. BLÖDSINN!"
HOMO ECONOMICUS. Rational Fool: Make a decision that benefits only you, lose 1 Friend. A rational utility maximizer who doesn't exist. (Ref: Game Theory)
THE FILTER BUBBLE. Echo Chamber: Ignore any card played by a 'Different' species. We only see what the algorithm wants us to see. (Ref: Pariser)
Do you know LONELINESS? Health Hazard: -1 to Quest Die. As deadly as 15 cigarettes a day. A biological warning signal.
DIGITAL DISTRACTION. Scroll Doom: Skip your turn to draw a card. We are alone together. Connection without demand. (Ref: Turkle)
INTRINSIC MOTIVATION. Flow State: Play an extra card if it fits the story perfectly. Doing it because you love it. Rewards can kill this. (Ref: Deci & Ryan)
Ever heard of HOMO COOPERATIVUS? Synergy: +1 to Quest Die for every player who helps. We are designed to work together. (Ref: Sennett)
BULLSHIT JOBS. Resignation: Discard a card to do nothing. Work that serves no purpose. Soul-destroying. (Ref: Graeber)
THE NUDGE. Choice Arch: Influence the next player's decision without forcing them. Small changes in context can change behavior. (Ref: Thaler)
HOMO HAPTICUS. Touch: Connect two separated cards. We cannot live without touch. The skin is our social organ. (Ref: Grunwald)
Do you know RESONANCE? Hartmut Rosa: Amplify the current 'Vibe'. When the world answers us. Not echo, but answer.
SKIN HUNGER. Desperation: Force a connection (play a card on top of another). A biological deficit. We wither without contact.
FLOW. Immersion: The Quest Die cannot be tipped this turn. Total absorption. The ego dissolves. (Ref: Csikszentmihalyi)
Ever heard of THE KILLING INHIBITION? Missed Shot: Negate an attack or aggressive move. Most soldiers didn't shoot to kill. We are not natural killers. (Ref: Marshall)
THE CHRISTMAS TRUCE. Ceasefire: Pause the Quest Die for one round. When the propaganda failed, they played football. 1914.
PROPAGANDA. Dehumanize: Turn a 'Friend' card into an 'Enemy'. We need to be lied to in order to kill. (Ref: Bernays)
NON-VIOLENT RESISTANCE. Civil Disobedience: Stop the game flow to change a rule. Power comes from obedience. Withdraw it. (Ref: Gandhi)
Do you know THE ALPHA MYTH? Debunk: Remove a 'Leader' status. Real alphas are caretakers, not bullies. (Ref: Mech)
LEVELING MECHANISM. Ridicule: The player with the most cards must discard one. Cutting down the tall poppy. Keeping egos in check. (Ref: Boehm)
CORRUPTION OF POWER. Brain Damage: Gain power, but lose Empathy (cannot assist others). Power causes brain damage. It shuts down mirror neurons. (Ref: Keltner)
Ever heard of EGALITARIANISM? Round Table: Everyone draws a card. For 95% of human history, we lived as equals. (Ref: Graeber/Wengrow)
THE HELPER TODDLER. Innate Goodness: Aid another player freely. We help before we can talk. It's not taught, it's there. (Ref: Warneken)
ALLOPARENTING. It Takes A Village: Use another player's Skill/Power. Mothers and Others. We share the burden. (Ref: Hrdy)
HOMO LUDENS (PLAY). Reset: Clear the Stage (it was just a game). Play is the foundation of culture. It requires trust. (Ref: Huizinga)
Do you know CONDITIONED SELF? Schooling: Force a card to conform to a specific suit/color. We are taught to compete. We are molded. (Ref: Kohn)
IMMANUEL KANT. Categorical Imperative: Establish a Universal Rule for the game. "The starry sky above me, the moral law within me."
ERICH FROMM. To Be: Immunize an Actor against material loss. "To Have or To Be? That is the question of sanity."
Ever heard of MARTIN BUBER? I and Thou: Create an unbreakable bond between two Actors. "All real living is meeting. No 'It', only 'Thou.'"
HANNAH ARENDT. Action: Start a new narrative thread (Quest). "The banality of evil. But also the power of beginning."
PROTOPIA. Incremental Gain: +1 to the Die roll. Not Utopia. Just a little bit better than yesterday. (Ref: Kevin Kelly)
TEAM HUMAN. Find the Others: Unite all players against the Quest. Being human is a team sport. (Ref: Douglas Rushkoff)
Do you know SELF-FULFILLING PROPHECY? Manifest: If you say it happens, it happens. If we believe we are selfish, we become selfish. Change the story.
HOPE. The Verb: Restart the game if you lose. Hope is a verb with its sleeves rolled up. (Ref: Solnit/Orr)
BLÖDSINN! (NONSENSE). Interrupt: Cancel the last action. Shout 'BlödsInn!' When the story gets boring or fake, hit the reset button.
Ever heard of KAYFABIZARRO? The Work: Treat the game as real. Overact your next turn. It's fake, but the emotion is real. That's the point.
THE SCISSORS. Cut: Physically cut a card in half to destroy it forever. The ultimate tool of the DIY anarchist.
THE GLUE STICK. Mashup: Stick two cards together permanently. Make connections where there are none.
